narrative: The PR adds dismissal of the action's own blocking review at the round cap. Most of rounds 1-4 is fallout from round-0 fixes. Moving isOutstandingBlock off the transport (F1) left a stale doc claim (F7), whose two-place checklist missed the release-flag field (F12), whose projection missed blockStillHolds (F17). Relocating the 'withholds approval' warning took three attempts (F1, F9, F13) because each placement was an audit of callers. The re-read added for F8 was documented in CLAUDE.md but not README, and its message contradicted its own causes (F15, F16, F19). Round 2 consisted entirely of fix-caused findings; rounds 3 and 4 each also had at least one finding that would have appeared anyway (F14, F23).
guidance_observations: Each structural fix moved a responsibility, and the docs and the second call sites describing that responsibility were swept one round later rather than in the same commit.
The agent twice claimed a symptom was gone (warnings 'leave that path') when the fix had only made it rarer; checking such a claim against every caller before replying would have saved a round.
README and CLAUDE.md describe the same mechanism in prose, so every behaviour change has to be applied to both; three findings came from updating only one.
Fixes were usually test-backed and mutation-checked, but the relocation (F13) and the notice guard (F23) shipped without tests, and one drew a further round.
